CON-001Implemented

Purpose-specific notice and consent ledger

Core · Compliance OS · Owner: Privacy and Data Protection

Acceptance boundary

Purpose-specific notice and consent ledger is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Executable first-party controls and automated evidence exist for CON-001; production operation still depends on institution configuration and monitored deployment.

Review currency

Last reviewed 2026-07-15. Revalidate when implementation, policy, provider or operating evidence changes.
